testcase.description: BIR51 FS — Full HKFRS, Comparative Balance Sheet

variation.name: bir51_fs_hkfrs_comparative
variation.description: A valid full-HKFRS financial statements file that tags ird_fs:Assets and ird_fs:EquityAndLiabilities at two instants. Current year (31 March 2026) is 500 = 500 in both HKD and USD. Prior year (31 March 2025) is 6,001,000 at decimals="-3" and 6,000,000 at decimals="-6", whose intervals overlap. NVAD-E-1300 must compare within a context and unit, and must not fire.
